flow_evidence: Lines 23-24 set NONCE_LEN to 12. Lines 85-88 initialize 12 bytes, then overwrite bytes 4..12 with frame_index.to_be_bytes(). The cipher receives 0x00000000 || uint64_be(frame_index), not an unchanged all-zero value.
Lines 111-114 and 133-136 pass the computed nonce to AES-256-GCM-SIV. Lines 337-352 enumerate each nonempty frame once; lines 354-362 seal the empty blob as its only frame at index zero.

Lines 160-165 derive the AEAD subkey from the tenant DataEncryptionKey and blob key_seed. Lines 325-329 select a BLAKE3 plaintext digest for content mode or a caller-provided salt; lines 587-590 fill stream salts from OsRng.
Lines 706-715 use a 256-bit content digest and bound the frame count below the 64-bit index space. Lines 780-794 authenticate the seed kind, key seed, total length, frame index, and frame count.

Lines 593-607 reject non-SIV and nondeterministic backends. Lines 898-919 prove the caller contract: content mode deliberately repeats ciphertext only for identical tenant/plaintext to preserve deduplication; stream mode uses fresh random salts. crates/nimbus-blob/src/encrypted.rs:41-50 selects these modes.
alerts.analysis: The zero literal is only the fixed high 32 bits of an injective 64-bit frame counter. A blob has no repeated frame index under its subkey. Different content or random salts derive different subkeys, subject to the 256-bit digest or salt collision bound. The deliberate identical-content repeat uses identical plaintext and AAD under AES-GCM-SIV, matching the documented dedup contract. RFC 8452 defines this AEAD as nonce-misuse resistant; the intended equality leakage is already required by content-addressed deduplication.
alerts.proposed_dismissal_comment: False positive. The zero literal is only the 32-bit prefix of a 96-bit nonce; the other 64 bits are overwritten with the big-endian frame index before AES-256-GCM-SIV use. Frame indices are unique under each content-hash- or random-salt-derived blob subkey. Identical-content repeats are deliberate for deduplication and use identical plaintext/AAD with nonce-misuse-resistant AES-GCM-SIV.
alerts.dismissed_comment: The nonce is a 32-bit zero prefix plus a 64-bit frame counter, unique per blob subkey. Subkeys derive from content hashes or random salts. Identical-content repeats use identical plaintext/AAD under AES-GCM-SIV for the documented dedup contract.
alerts.root_review: Confirmed source and callers independently against baseline b527e1742.

flow_evidence: Lines 21-25 return Ok(false) only when the .dek-rotation marker is absent.

crates/nimbus-crypto/src/runtime.rs:84-103 and crates/nimbus-cli/src/encryption/rotate.rs:434-488 discard this status with ?. Key resolution uses EnvelopeKeyring; rotation creates its new DEK separately at rotate.rs:467.
rotate.rs:573-576 fills the replacement 32-byte DEK from OsRng. The only value-consuming caller is the test assertion at rotation.rs:260-278.
alerts.analysis: false is a recovery-status flag. It never becomes bytes and never flows to encryption, decryption, wrapping, derivation, or credential code.
alerts.proposed_dismissal_comment: False positive. This false literal means that no DEK-rotation marker was present. Both production callers discard the Result<bool> status with ?.
